details:
Talox has told me to create a canny about an issue i encountered after the VRChat's outage on 23/05.

The quest/mobile version no longer functioned, despite not having updated the world in 1/2 months with no issues, it somehow broke after the VRChat's outage, after which any quest/mobile user whom attempted to join the world could no longer load in and would get send back to their home world directly, reuploading solved this issue. 

Not sure if anyone else is affected besides me.
